backend.source_model_description: Large heterogeneous knowledge graph; precomputed label statistics and candidate-edge scoring

studies.design: Offline ranking evaluation with crowdsourced relevance judgments
tasks: 65 QALD7-derived exploratory graph queries and325 fact-contextualization queries
comparators: MLE, KL, pseudo-relevance-feedback variants, Personalized PageRank, Surprise and random ranking
measures: Four-point relevance judgments, NDCG@1–20, MAP at different query sizes and running time
studies.results: With a single example entity, no method significantly beat random ranking; with an edge or larger query, KL with pseudo-relevance feedback improved ranking. Candidate retrieval/query answering averaged under1s and scoring took milliseconds
limitations: Ranking judgments are not end-to-end exploration task success; unique crowd-worker count is not reported. The text prints NDCG around5.5, inconsistent with Figure3 scale; that number is not used.
